g.title: A Gostman folder read by the workspace package, a Postman or Bruno export, or an OpenAPI file, loaded into one runner.Collection. Folders are read by a bounded pool of readers sized from the CPU count.
runner/data.go parses the file into rows. Each row is one iteration with its own variables, so one collection tests many inputs.
Resolves folder filters, tags, --only, iterations and --parallel into an ordered list of executions before anything is sent.
Receives the ordered list from the run plan and handles each execution in turn.
